subject: increasing font size for prompts
body:
Hello Shreya,

To use H1-6 HTML tags which can affect the text size you should first download the survey definition file, edit the JSON, and then upload it. You can read more about it at https://learn.avicennaresearch.com/reference/survey/#versions-import-and-export.
Also, to see an example of how these tags can used please refer to the HTML h1 to h6 tag (w3schools.com). 

You can still use the Bold functionality directly from the editor but we do not support using those H1-6 tags in the editor.

Unfortunately, we have an issue with the Import Survey Definition File feature so it might not work as expected at the moment but we are working on fixing it and the issue should be resolved soon.

Do not hesitate to contact us for any further assistance.

Best regards,
Milad

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/24106/cf373fca399049d4
